title: disease/gene/phenotype graph
description: A bounded slice of the Monarch Initiative biomedical KG (CC-BY): a disease neighbourhood linking genes (biolink:Gene), phenotypes (biolink:has_phenotype), gene-gene interactions (biolink:interacts_with) and taxa, with rdfs:labels and skos:exactMatch cross-references.
example_queries: SELECT ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } GROUP BY ?p ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 20

PREFIX bl: <https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?name WHERE { ?ph a bl:PhenotypicFeature ; rdfs:label ?name } ORDER BY ?name LIMIT 100

PREFIX bl: <https://w3id.org/biolink/vocab/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?name (COUNT(?o) AS ?deg) WHERE { ?g bl:interacts_with ?o . ?g rdfs:label ?name } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?deg) LIMIT 15
